title.narrative: Reducing the burden, ensuring sustainability and accelerating progress towards malaria elimination in Kenya - Kenya (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Kenya, Malaria, The National Treasury & Economic Planning of the Government of Kenya (TNT)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria incidence and deaths by at least 75 percent of the 2016 levels by 2023. The objectives of this program are: To protect 100 percent of people living in malaria risk areas through access to appropriate malaria preventive interventions by 2023. To manage 100 percent of suspected malaria cases according to the Kenya malaria treatment guidelines by 2023. To establish systems for malaria elimination in targeted counties by 2023. To increase utilisation of appropriate malaria interventions in Kenya to at least 80 percent by 2023. To strengthen malaria surveillance and use of information to improve decision making for programme performance. To provide leadership and management for optimal implementation of malaria interventions at all levels, for the achievement of all objectives by 2023
